title: gentiana germanica subsp. solstitialis
intro: Gentiana germanica subsp. solstitialis, commonly known as German Gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family, characterized by its unique yellow flowers and medicinal properties. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include aiding digestion and relieving symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, such as stomach pain and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of German Gentian include its ability to stimulate digestive enzymes and enhance appetite, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, gentiopicroside, and gentiogenicoside, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
